newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Chicago Corp initiates telecoms.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Chicago Corp initiates telecoms.

text.p: Chicago Corp said Monday it has initiated coverage on various telecommunications companies.
Chicago Corp said it started coverage of GTE Corp with a buy rating. GTE recently introduced long distance service, which the research firm said appears to be a "clear winner".
BellSouth Corp, Ameritech Corp, Bell Atlantic Corp, NYNEX Corp, U S West Communications Group, SBC Communications Inc and Pacific Telesis Group were initiated with hold ratings.
Chicago Corp said local telephone service competition was about to take off in the above companies' goegraphical areas, with no date certain for their entrances into the long distance market.
